prompt.context: Your client, Phone Com, is a telecommunications company with high brand recognition only in the United States. The company has grown primarily through a series of acquisitions over the last thirty years. Less than a month ago, the CEO announced another acquisition of a large satellite television company called Sat-Light Inc. Sat-Light is stable but slow growing. In order to make this merger valuable, the CEO has asked your team to identify: 1) synergies from the merger, 2) ideas for differentiated product offerings, and 3) opportunities for new growth.
prompt.question: Please structure your approach to identifying synergies from the merger, differentiated product ideas, and growth opportunities for the combined Phone Com / Sat-Light entity.

clarifying_info.q: What products does each company currently offer?
clarifying_info.a: Phone Com offers mobility, broadband, and television. Sat-Light offers television and broadband (broadband through a third party).

clarifying_info.q: Are we focused only on the US market?
clarifying_info.a: We are focused on North and South America. Phone Com has limited distribution in South America; Sat-Light has new distribution in South America.

framework: 1. Synergies — cost reduction (personnel, IT systems, supply chain) AND revenue-generating (ad sales, content, bundling, collections)
2. Differentiated Product Offerings — creative, mobile/TV convergence ideas (e.g., TV everywhere, DVR-to-phone streaming app)
3. Growth Opportunities — South America expansion, bundling, channel/distribution optimization in US, commercial/B2B segment

questions.prompt: What are the key synergies from combining Phone Com and Sat-Light?
questions.guidance: Candidate should distinguish cost synergies from revenue synergies. Cost: personnel reductions (easy), IT systems consolidation (easy), supply chain (medium). Revenue: bundling (easy), content contracts (hard), advertising sales (hard), collections (hard). Strong candidates note both dimensions unprompted.

questions.prompt: Brainstorm at least three differentiated product ideas leveraging the combined mobile + satellite TV capabilities.
questions.guidance: No wrong answer. Examples: TV everywhere enhancement, app that streams DVR content to mobile phone, integrated mobility+TV bundle with single bill, exclusive sports/content packages, mobile alerts tied to live TV events. Candidate should demonstrate creativity under pressure and connect mobile and television assets.

questions.prompt: The CEO wants to know the television expansion opportunity: how many US households are NOT currently served by any TV provider? Sat-Light serves 30M households, Phone Com serves 10M, Competitor 1 serves 15M, Competitor 2 serves 32M, Competitor 3 serves 7M. All customers are unique (no overlap).
questions.guidance: Candidate should market-size US households, subtract all served households, and draw a strategic conclusion about saturation.

math.setup: Estimate US households: ~320M people / ~3 people per household ≈ 107M households. Subtract all served households from total.
steps: Avg household size ≈ 3 people → ~107 million households
math.answer: ~13 million unserved US households. The market is extremely saturated (~88% penetration). The remaining households likely include cord-cutters, households with infrastructure/access barriers, or households that cannot afford TV service — meaning organic growth opportunity in the US is very limited.

questions.prompt: Given limited US expansion opportunity, discuss opportunities and key risks for the three growth strategies identified in your framework.
questions.guidance: 1) South America Expansion: large unsegmented opportunity, but risks include corrupt/fragmented government, country-by-country regulatory differences, technology infrastructure far behind US, and high required investment. 2) Bundling: combined bill with reduced pricing is attractive to customers; risks include differentiating from competitors, IT upgrades for a unified bill, and installation logistics (same technicians installing two different products). 3) Commercial/B2B: households are only part of the addressable market — businesses represent an untapped segment; risks include defining a sales strategy, resourcing, creating a differentiated commercial product and pricing package.

brainstorming.prompt: What differentiated product offerings could the combined Phone Com + Sat-Light entity bring to market that leverage both mobile and satellite TV assets?

categories.name: Mobile-TV Convergence
ideas: TV everywhere — stream live satellite TV to any mobile device
App that streams DVR-recorded content to smartphone or tablet
Push mobile alerts for live events or breaking news tied to TV subscriptions

categories.name: Bundling & Packaging
ideas: Quad-play bundle: mobility + broadband + satellite TV + landline on a single bill
Family plan tying multiple mobile lines to a TV subscription discount
Introductory bundle targeting new South America customers

categories.name: Content & Exclusivity
ideas: Exclusive sports or entertainment content packages
Partnerships with streaming services for an integrated mobile+TV content library
Local-language content bundles for South American markets

categories.name: Commercial / B2B
ideas: Business TV + broadband + mobile bundles for SMBs
Digital signage solutions powered by satellite TV infrastructure
Managed mobility + connectivity packages for enterprise clients

recommendation: We have identified cost synergies (personnel, IT, supply chain) and revenue synergies (bundling, ad sales) from combining Phone Com and Sat-Light.
The recommended differentiated product is a mobile-TV convergence offering (e.g., DVR-to-phone streaming app / TV everywhere) that uniquely combines both companies' assets.

US television market is ~88% saturated; meaningful domestic expansion is limited — growth should focus on South America (large unsegmented opportunity) and the commercial segment (B2B currently untapped).
risks: South America: fragmented regulatory environment, under-developed technology infrastructure, significant capital investment required
Bundling: need IT upgrades for a unified bill and coordination of installation resources
Commercial: requires a differentiated pricing/product strategy and dedicated sales resources
next_steps: Conduct deeper technology and infrastructure assessment for South America mobile and TV capabilities
Research current market share and competitive dynamics in the commercial/B2B segment
Evaluate IT systems integration roadmap for combined billing and customer management
